structural.summary: 双进程 desktop application：Tauri Rust shell (supervisor) + Python agent server (sidecar)。Python 侧以 TurnEngine 为架构中心，SessionManager 为 orchestrator god-class，周围环绕 providers/connectors/mcp/permissions/inbox/automation/personas/agents 八大子系统。

layers.name: Desktop Shell Layer
layers.responsibility: 进程监督、单实例锁、close-to-tray、keep-awake、SPA 注入 sidecar port

layers.name: Orchestration Layer
layers.responsibility: session 生命周期、cross-session coordination、engine 装配、inbound 路由、scheduled task 执行

layers.name: Agent Loop Layer
layers.responsibility: iteration-based agent loop、provider stream、tool authorize/execute、approval interception、durable resume

layers.name: Agent Surface Layer
layers.responsibility: Agent 抽象 (Code/Chat/Cowork) + Persona 序列化形式 + Skill 可插拔 capability

layers.name: Provider Layer
layers.responsibility: ProviderClient ABC + native Anthropic/Gemini + OpenAI-compat vendor 路由 + ModelCapabilities 降级

layers.name: Connector Layer
layers.responsibility: BasePlatformAdapter 契约 + adapters (Slack/Telegram/GitHub) + RelayHub + integration_tools tool surface + descriptors 数据驱动注册

layers.name: MCP Layer
layers.responsibility: MCPManager async-native 包装官方 mcp SDK + stdio/http transport + OAuth + 工具桥接

layers.name: Permission Layer
layers.responsibility: 5 mode + RiskClass + 4 层 allowlist + §25 standing rule + ApprovalOutcome 持久化

layers.name: Inbox Layer
layers.owner: coworker/inbox.py + inbox_routing.py + unattended.py + unrouted.py + parked.py + mentions.py + selfwake.py
layers.responsibility: cross-session human-attention queue + 多 surface 同一 item + idempotent + first-responder-wins + self-wake suspend/resume

layers.name: Automation Layer
layers.responsibility: cron scheduler + run-once-catch-up + skip-on-overlap + selfwake 集成 + task-scoped standing rule seeding

behavioral.summary: 控制流中心是 TurnEngine._loop()：iteration-based while + provider stream + tool 两阶段 (authorize 串行 / execute 并行) + approval out-of-band + durable resume。数据流是 canonical OpenAI-shape history，所有 provider per-call 转换。SessionManager 在外围装配 engine + 路由 inbound + 执行 scheduled task。

flows.name: Agent Turn 主循环
flows.trigger: user message / scheduled task / inbound mention / self-wake resume
steps: SessionManager.deliver_to_session 判断 busy vs idle
busy → engine.queue_steering 插队 live turn 下一步
idle → mark_running + get_engine (load SessionRecord → build_engine + apply task rules + mention grants + record.grants)
engine.run() → _loop() iteration while
_astream() thread+Queue 桥接 blocking provider stream 到 async loop
每轮 _handle_tool_calls 两阶段：顺序 authorize (interactive 不能并发) + 并行/串行 execute (risk_level=low 并行，writes/shell 串行)
approval needed → emit PERMISSION_REQUIRED + await approver (inbox_approver 转 InboxItem + store.wait)
turn.tool_calls 空 + 无 steering → TURN_END

flows.name: Durable Resume 三层
flows.trigger: restart / surface reconnect / session 生命周期恢复

layers.mechanism: 重放 trailing assistant message 的 UNANSWERED tool_calls，_unanswered_trailing_tool_calls 从持久化 messages 反推 (role==assistant + tool_calls - 已有 role==tool 结果)
(session_id, tool_call_id) idempotent + first-responder-wins，for_tool_call 找到已有 item 复用而非 re-prompt
重建 engine 并应用 task rules + mention grants + record.grants，agent 'stays resumable forever, works with no live socket'

flows.name: Permission End-to-End Chain
steps: PermissionEngine.evaluate (5 mode + RiskClass + 4 层 allowlist)
READ_ONLY_MODES + consequential → deny
is_write + path 不在 writable root → deny
not consequential → allow
AUTO → allow
shell + command allowlist → allow
tool in session_allow_tools → allow
task_rules (§25 standing rule) → allow
CUSTOM + auto_allow_tools → allow
else needs_user=True
engine._authorize emit PERMISSION_REQUIRED + await approver
SessionManager.inbox_approver 转 InboxItem + store.wait()
resolve from any surface (in-app/Slack button/reply/[ow:id] token)
ApprovalOutcome (ONCE/ALWAYS_TOOL/ALWAYS_COMMAND/DENY)
ALWAYS_* 落 session_allow 或 task_rules

flows.name: Inbound Message Routing
steps: _dispatch_inbound 路由分层
channel/group → channel_buffer.record + subscriptions.for_channel fan-out
mentions_me 优先 _route_mention spawn per-thread coworker
否则 judgement-only framing 让 agent 自决 silence vs reply
DM → dm_session() 或 park unrouted

flows.name: Scheduled Task Execution
steps: Scheduler._loop 第一遍 _tick(trigger='catchup') 跑所有 due tasks
asyncio.sleep(30) 循环 _tick(trigger='schedule')
extra_tick 调 WakeStore.due() resume due sessions (selfwake 集成)
_run_scheduled_task 把每个 run 变成 durable conversation thread
_build_task_engine (No scheduling tools inside scheduled run, 防止 re-schedule)
register engine up-front (parked approval 能 find it)
opening framing 'schedule already fired, execute now'
save as continuable session

flows.name: Provider Stream Bridging
steps: produce() 在 executor 里跑 provider.stream() (blocking)
每个 chunk 通过 loop.call_soon_threadsafe 投回 queue
queue.get() 与 self._cancel.wait() 用 asyncio.wait FIRST_COMPLETED 竞速
stalled stream (pre-first-token wait, wedged connection) 也能被 Stop 打断

ownership.summary: TurnEngine 拥有 agent loop + messages + tool execution；SessionManager 拥有 engines + 18+ stores + 路由；PermissionEngine 拥有决策 (session_allow/task_rules/auto_allow 三层 allowlist 各有 owner)；Inbox 拥有 cross-session human-attention items (idempotent by session_id+tool_call_id)；Scheduler 拥有 cron task lifecycle；WakeStore 拥有 wake records。

ownership_table.lifecycle: 持久化在 SessionRecord，_outbound_messages 每次 strip sidecars
lazy build via get_engine, 缓存
持久化，主要用于 relax MCP 保守默认
runtime add/remove，permission + file tools + context injector 同步看到
持久化在 canonical assistant message，owning provider consume，其他 provider strip

extension.summary: 四类扩展点：Agent (top-level surface via traits) / Persona (serialized Agent via YAML frontmatter) / Skill (Anthropic-format loadable capability) / Connector (data-driven via ConnectorDescriptor)。Provider 通过 ProviderDescriptor 注册。MCP server 通过 MCPServerDef 配置。

extension_points.name: Agent extension via traits
extension_points.mechanism: Agent 子类 + traits (family/messaging/connectors)，build_engine 按 traits 分支装配 tools
extension_points.extension_contract: family='code' + workspace → explorer subagents; family='knowledge' + root_list → request_directory + scheduling + selfwake; messaging → send_message/send_file; connectors → integration_tools

extension_points.name: Persona as serialized Agent
extension_points.mechanism: PersonaManifest YAML frontmatter + markdown body，to_agent() 物化成 runtime Agent
extension_points.extension_contract: id/name/system_prompt/tools/family/workspace/messaging/connectors/default_permission_mode/recommended_models/skills/mcp/recommends/builtin/source；persona id 必须 filesystem-safe slug，无效 manifest 抛 ManifestError

extension_points.name: Skill as loadable capability
extension_points.mechanism: Anthropic-format skill，ANY agent can pull in，load_skill 是 tool (progressive disclosure: skill catalog 在 instructions)
extension_points.extension_contract: Skill 与 Agent 区分明确：Agent 是 surface 的人格，Skill 是可插拔 capability

extension_points.name: Connector via ConnectorDescriptor (data-driven)
extension_points.mechanism: dataclass + fields (UI 渲染) + instructions (wizard) + validate (real API call)，Adding a connector is (mostly) data, not UI code
extension_points.extension_contract: auth (bot_token|socket_app|oauth|token|api_token|none) + fields + instructions + validate + brand_color + logo + aliases + mcp_url + experimental + managed + account_field

extension_points.name: Provider via ProviderDescriptor
extension_points.mechanism: ProviderDescriptor + build(profile, secrets) factory，DESCRIPTORS 列表含 12 个 provider
extension_points.extension_contract: name/title/needs_key/fields + build factory + recommended_model + env_key；_openai_compat builder 包装 OpenAI-compat vendor 为 first-class provider

extension_points.name: MCP server via MCPServerDef
extension_points.mechanism: MCPManager ensure() lazy-connect，stdio + streamable-http 两种 transport
extension_points.extension_contract: 每个 server 在 dedicated asyncio task，transport + ClientSession 生命周期绑在 task (anyio cancel scopes task-affine)

extension_points.name: Connector tool surface (integration_tools)
extension_points.extension_contract: tool name → approval default + owning connector，让 read/write 分类与 call-site flag 解耦

extension_points.name: Tool catalog expand (CODE_CAPABILITIES)
extension_points.mechanism: code_agent 用 catalog.expand(CODE_CAPABILITIES, context) 构造工具集，从 vetted catalog 展开

evolution.summary: 证据主要来自代码注释和 docstring 提及的历史决策，无直接 git 历史分析。关键演进：per-agent-name branching → traits-based branching；手写 tool factory → catalog.expand；Slack-only relay → RelayHub 抽象 (GitHub 成为第二 relay provider)；aisuite as provider → aisuite as OpenAI-compat plug-in + 自建 native provider；fire-and-forget scheduled task → durable conversation thread。

evolution_events.evidence: 注释 'replace the old per-agent-name branching in build_engine / manager' (ev-017, ev-011)
evolution_events.impact: Agent 抽象从硬编码 if-else 转为 traits 驱动的 declarative 装配

evolution_events.evidence: 注释 'was a hand-written factory' 已废弃 (ev-012)
evolution_events.impact: Tool 装配从 imperative factory 转为 data-driven catalog expand

evolution_events.evidence: 注释 'when GitHub became the second relay provider we abstracted RelayHub out' (ev-023)
evolution_events.impact: Relay 从 Slack 专属转为 multi-provider shared transport，cloud 推所有用户 events 下一根 WS

evolution_events.event: aisuite as provider → aisuite as OpenAI-compat plug-in + 自建 native provider
evolution_events.evidence: 注释 'v1 ships OpenAIProvider; an AISuiteProvider slots in later (P12) without touching the engine, since aisuite is OpenAI-API-shaped' (ev-018)；AnthropicProvider 完整 native Messages API 实现 (ev-020)
evolution_events.impact: Provider 层从 aisuite 统一抽象转为 native 实现 (Anthropic/Gemini) + OpenAI-compat vendor 路由，因 API drift 适配需要 model-family-specific 处理

evolution_events.event: fire-and-forget scheduled task → durable conversation thread
evolution_events.evidence: 注释 'scheduled agent is no longer fire-and-forget' (ev-030)
evolution_events.impact: Scheduled task 从一次性执行转为可续 conversation，parked approval 能 find engine，task 级 standing rule seeding

evolution_events.evidence: pre-4.6 vs 4.6+/Claude 5 thinking config；Fable/Mythos 5 safety classifier refusal fallback (ev-020)
evolution_events.impact: Provider 必须跟踪 vendor API drift，aisuite 不可能提供这种 model-family-specific 适配

evolution_events.evidence: 注释 'hosted chat templates reject orphaned tool_calls, and durable-resume would otherwise re-prompt them' (ev-016)
evolution_events.impact: Stop 路径必须给每个 pending tool_call 写 tool-error message，历史里永远不留 orphan

evolution_events.event: PyInstaller onefile bootloader 进程关系
evolution_events.evidence: 注释 'under PyInstaller onefile the python process is a grandchild (bootloader in between), so getppid() never points at us' (ev-015)
evolution_events.impact: 不能用 getppid() reparenting check，必须用 COWORKER_EXIT_WITH_PARENT + COWORKER_PARENT_PID 显式 sidecar self-exit

entities.description: Task-scoped {tool: {allowed targets}} seeded from ScheduledTask，external-risk only (never exec/write-local)，exact-target binding 让 connector tool auto-allow 安全

entities.name: roots (shared mutable list)
entities.description: Workspace folders，Kept by reference and re-read on every check，runtime add/remove takes effect without rebuilding engine

findings.title: 架构中心是 TurnEngine 而非 SessionManager
findings.statement: TurnEngine (engine.py) 是单一 agent loop，去掉它系统不能跑：manager 装配它、inbox 挂起它、scheduler 重建它、所有 inbound/outbound 都经它。SessionManager 是 orchestrator 但不是中心——它构造并持有 engine，真正执行 agent 行为的是 engine

findings.title: 三层 durable 设计形成端到端 resumable agent
findings.statement: (1) TurnEngine.resume() 重放 trailing unanswered tool_calls (跨 restart); (2) InboxStore (session_id, tool_call_id) idempotent + first-responder-wins (跨 surface); (3) SessionManager.deliver_to_session + get_engine 重建 engine 并应用 task rules + mention grants + record.grants (跨 session 生命周期)——agent 'stays resumable forever, works with no live socket'

findings.title: Tauri shell 是 supervisor 不是 peer
findings.statement: Tauri Rust shell 在 setup() 第一件事 spawn Python openworker-server 作为 managed sidecar，绑 random free localhost port。进程关系通过 COWORKER_EXIT_WITH_PARENT=1 + COWORKER_PARENT_PID 显式建立 (因 PyInstaller onefile bootloader 让 getppid() 不可靠)。Close-to-tray 保持 MyHelper + scheduler 运行，单实例锁防止重复 sidecar

findings.title: Agent 是 thin surface，TurnEngine 是 real loop
findings.statement: coworker/agents/ 仅 ~310 LOC 跨 8 文件，Agent 子类主要定义 system_prompt + traits (family/messaging/connectors)。TurnEngine 由 build_engine (agent.py) 装配，按 traits 分支决定 tool 集合。Agent 抽象的职责边界是 'surface 的人格定义'，不是 agent loop 实现

findings.title: Persona ⊇ Skill，persona 是 Agent 的可序列化形式
findings.statement: Persona = YAML frontmatter (identity + capability declaration) + markdown body (system prompt)，与 SKILL.md 同 frontmatter-markdown shape 但字段更多。PersonaManifest.to_agent() 把 persona 物化成 runtime Agent。Persona 携带 recommends (connector/mcp + reason + tier) 实现 persona-driven connection recommendations。唯一 builtin persona (ops.md) 揭示 'operational deliverable' 工作流设计意图

findings.title: Native providers 因 API drift 适配需要 model-family-specific 处理
findings.statement: OpenWorker 自建 AnthropicProvider (完整 native Messages API) 而非用 aisuite，因 Anthropic Messages API 与 chat.completions 差异大到必须有专门 converter，且 extended thinking verbatim replay + API drift 适配 (pre-4.6/4.6+/Claude 5 thinking config + Fable/Mythos 5 safety classifier refusal fallback) 是 aisuite 不可能提供的。aisuite 被定位为 OpenAI-compatible plug-in (P12)，不是 provider 抽象基座

findings.title: Connector = adapter (base.py) + tool surface (integration_tools.py) + descriptor (data)
findings.statement: 三层分工：BasePlatformAdapter 是 platform-agnostic 契约 (connect/disconnect/send + target token)；integration_tools 是 connector 的 tool surface 层 (local-first credentials from SecretStore，aisuite ToolMetadata 容器)；ConnectorDescriptor 是 data-driven 注册 (auth + fields + instructions + validate)。tool_defs.approval_for_tool / connector_for_tool 是 §36 registry 让 read/write 分类与 call-site flag 解耦

findings.title: Slack 双 adapter 解决 manual vs managed multi-workspace
findings.statement: SlackAdapter (Socket Mode) = manual bot+app tokens, 单 workspace, direct WebSocket, 无 cloud；SlackRelayAdapter (Managed Relay) = 'Add to Slack' OAuth, 无需 typed tokens, 多 workspace, events 从 OpenWorker Cloud 经一个 authenticated WS 推下。RelayHub 是 ONE desktop↔cloud relay socket shared by every provider adapter (GitHub 成为第二 relay provider 时抽出)。多 workspace 关键解法是 team-qualified reply handle (slack:T…/C…) via slack_addr.qualify()

findings.title: 自建 MCP client 因 async-native + anyio task affinity
findings.statement: MCPManager 是 'thin async MCP client over the official mcp SDK' 但自建一层，原因明确：'Async-native (no nest_asyncio, no second event loop): each server runs in a dedicated asyncio task that opens the transport + ClientSession, keeps them alive until shutdown, then closes them in the same task — required because the SDK transports use anyio cancel scopes that must be entered and exited on one task'

findings.title: Permission end-to-end chain + §25 standing rule 是 automation-safe 关键
findings.statement: PermissionEngine.evaluate (5 mode + RiskClass + 4 层 allowlist) → engine._authorize emit PERMISSION_REQUIRED + approver callback → SessionManager.inbox_approver 转 InboxItem + store.wait() → resolve from any surface → ApprovalOutcome → engine 继续 → ALWAYS_* 落 session_allow 或 task_rules。§25 standing rule = {tool: {allowed targets}} seeded from ScheduledTask，external-risk only (never exec/write-local)，exact-target binding 让 connector tool auto-allow 安全——automation run 中 agent 对 declared target 自动放行不阻塞 scheduler

findings.title: Inbox 是 cross-session human-attention queue (多 surface 同一 item)
findings.statement: Inbox 是 'canonical, cross-session human-attention queue'，holds approval/question/notification/directory/plan 五种 kind，是 'store of record; messaging connectors / mobile are transports of the same items'。状态机 pending→resolved 一次，idempotent + first-responder-wins by (session_id, tool_call_id)。visibility 区分 INLINE (attended session 在 composer 答) vs INBOX (Unattended session 进 cross-session queue)

findings.title: Scheduler 双 policy (run-once-catch-up + skip-on-overlap) 解决 desktop app 关闭问题
findings.statement: run-once-catch-up (due tasks fire once on startup then resume) + skip-on-overlap (_running_ids set, previous still going 则 skip) 解决 desktop app 关闭后 scheduled task 触发问题。extra_tick 调 WakeStore.due() resume due sessions，cron task 和 selfwake 共享同一 scheduler loop。_run_scheduled_task 把每个 run 变成 durable conversation thread (No scheduling tools inside scheduled run 防止 re-schedule)

findings.title: SessionManager god-class 是协调复杂度的 deliberate trade-off
findings.statement: SessionManager ~100+ 方法 跨 13 类职责，持有 18+ stores。为何未拆：所有 cross-cutting state (engines/stores/permissions seeding/routing) 都需 shared access；方法虽多但都围绕 'session 生命周期 + cross-session coordination' 这一中心；按职责拆需引入 13+ 协作对象 + shared state 同步机制，god-class 是单文件可读性 vs 多对象协议复杂度的 deliberate trade-off

findings.title: History 是 canonical OpenAI-shape，mid-thread system messages 不可靠
findings.statement: 所有 provider per-call 转换 (AnthropicProvider.convert_messages / GeminiProvider 等)。mid-thread system messages 不可靠 → context_provider 把 plan/discuss mode reminder + live directory list 注入 last user message (send-time only, never persisted)。switch_model 只是字段写 + notice 标记位置——让 mid-conversation 模型切换 + 多 provider 共享 history 成为可能

findings.title: Tool 两阶段执行：authorize 串行 + execute 并行/串行分流
findings.statement: _handle_tool_calls 两阶段：先顺序 authorize 所有 calls (approval 是 interactive 不能并发)，再执行；cleared 列表按 _parallel_safe 分流——metadata.risk_level=='low' 且非 requires_approval 的 (reads/searches/git queries) 用 asyncio.gather + asyncio.to_thread 并发执行，writes/shell/unannotated 严格按 call order 串行

findings.title: Stop 路径 orphan 防护 + durable resume 不双跑
findings.statement: request_interrupt() 设 _cancel + 触发 interrupt_hooks (kill running shell)；_interrupted_tool() 给每个 pending tool_call 写 tool-error message——'hosted chat templates reject orphaned tool_calls, and durable-resume would otherwise re-prompt them'。durable resume 时 for_tool_call() 找到已有 Inbox item (可能已 resolved) 复用而非 re-prompt，这是 engine.resume() 能跨 restart 不双跑的关键
